description.zh: 添加的后端服务器列表，每次调用最多可修改20个后端服务器。
description.en: The list of backend servers that you added. You can modify the weights of up to 20 backend servers in each request.
The ID of the instance that you use as the backend server.

description.zh:
后端服务器类型。取值：
- **ens**：ENS实例。
- **eni**：弹性网卡实例。
description.en:
The type of the backend server. Valid values:

- **ens**: ENS instance

- **eni**: elastic network interface (ENI)

description.zh:
后端服务器的权重。默认值：100，取值：**0**~**100**。

> 取值为0，表示不会将请求转发给该后端服务器。
description.en:
The weight of the backend server. Default value: 100. Valid values: **0** to **100**.

> The value 0 indicates that requests are not forwarded to the backend server.
The ID of the Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instance.

descriptions.en:
- Rate limit: 100 requests per second.

- up to 10 times per second per account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens set-backend-servers --load-balancer-id lb-5s7crik3yo3bp03gqrbp50000 --backend-servers Type=ens ServerId=i-5ze0o05xccvbljtn0000 Weight=20 --region cn-hangzhou
